verdict.rationale: Productboard's first-party MCP server explicitly lets a PM reschedule an initiative and move an initiative to a new release. It also supports creating and updating initiatives and releases, and release groups can be managed separately. Missing for 10: documentation of in-app roadmap rescheduling outside the agent/MCP path, depth on how dates and release reassignment behave, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reschedule initiatives and move them between releases as priorities change

citations.quote: Now you can use any agent to add new features, reschedule an initiative, or start building off a product specification.
Add features to initiatives, move an initiative to a new release, or create key results beneath an objective.
Create and update features, subfeatures, initiatives, releases, objectives, key results, companies, users, feedback, documents, and more directly from your agent
If you have multiple teams working out of the same workspace, each using a different release system, you can manage each as a separate release group.
